summary: Browser redirect script published as npm package main
details: The package's main file is a browser DOM script that injects a full-screen iframe pointing to https://mfmz.ruibys.cn/H.html?c=0gjr. The code references `document` and has no Node-side effects, no install/postinstall lifecycle scripts, and does not read installer environment or filesystem data. Requiring the module from Node throws on the missing `document` global. The package does not execute code on a developer's machine at install or require time; the redirect only fires if the script is embedded in a browser page.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
